evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive sets a forward cadence ('from now on') and frames an un-rehearsed rollback as a hypothetical gap — the conditional 'we have not rehearsed' suspends realis, while the maxim is an abstract principle.
Labels a planned, recurring cadence — future-scheduled and not yet enacted, naming a specific concrete activity.
Assigns a current, settled role to a named individual — present state, realis, concrete person.
